approvals_decision_consistency.name: approvals_decision_consistency
approvals_decision_consistency.value:
("core"."approvals"."status" = 'pending' AND "core"."approvals"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "core"."approvals"."decided_by" IS NULL)
        OR ("core"."approvals"."status" IN ('approved', 'rejected') AND "core"."approvals"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."approvals"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("core"."approvals"."status" = 'withdrawn' AND "core"."approvals"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

campaigns_dates_order.name: campaigns_dates_order
campaigns_dates_order.value: "marketing"."campaigns"."starts_on" IS NULL OR "marketing"."campaigns"."ends_on" IS NULL OR "marketing"."campaigns"."starts_on" <= "marketing"."campaigns"."ends_on"

content_assignments_has_assignee.name: content_assignments_has_assignee
content_assignments_has_assignee.value: "marketing"."content_assignments"."user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "marketing"."content_assignments"."staff_member_id" IS NOT NULL

content_items_approved_needs_approval.name: content_items_approved_needs_approval
content_items_approved_needs_approval.value: "marketing"."content_items"."approved_version_id" IS NULL OR "marketing"."content_items"."approval_id" IS NOT NULL

metric_values_value_matches_state.name: metric_values_value_matches_state
metric_values_value_matches_state.value:
("marketing"."metric_values"."state" IN ('reported', 'estimated') AND "marketing"."metric_values"."value" IS NOT NULL AND "marketing"."metric_values"."value" >= 0)
        OR ("marketing"."metric_values"."state" IN ('missing', 'not_applicable') AND "marketing"."metric_values"."value" IS NULL)

placements_linked_unless_ambiguous.name: placements_linked_unless_ambiguous
placements_linked_unless_ambiguous.value: "marketing"."placements"."ambiguous" OR ("marketing"."placements"."idea_id" IS NOT NULL AND "marketing"."placements"."content_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "marketing"."placements"."code" IS NOT NULL)

social_accounts_cadence_positive.name: social_accounts_cadence_positive
social_accounts_cadence_positive.value: ("marketing"."social_accounts"."cadence_max_per_day" IS NULL OR "marketing"."social_accounts"."cadence_max_per_day" > 0) AND ("marketing"."social_accounts"."cadence_max_per_week" IS NULL OR "marketing"."social_accounts"."cadence_max_per_week" > 0)

assessments_minutes_positive.name: assessments_minutes_positive
assessments_minutes_positive.value: ("academic"."assessments"."duration_minutes" IS NULL OR "academic"."assessments"."duration_minutes" > 0) AND ("academic"."assessments"."discussion_minutes" IS NULL OR "academic"."assessments"."discussion_minutes" >= 0)

attempts_shape.name: attempts_shape
attempts_shape.value: ("academic"."attempts"."status" = 'absent' AND "academic"."attempts"."responses" IS NULL) OR ("academic"."attempts"."status" = 'submitted' AND "academic"."attempts"."responses" IS NOT NULL)

batches_dates_order.name: batches_dates_order
batches_dates_order.value: "academic"."batches"."start_date" IS NULL OR "academic"."batches"."end_date" IS NULL OR "academic"."batches"."start_date" <= "academic"."batches"."end_date"

calendar_exclusions_shape.name: calendar_exclusions_shape
calendar_exclusions_shape.value: ("academic"."calendar_exclusions"."date" IS NOT NULL AND "academic"."calendar_exclusions"."period_start" IS NULL AND "academic"."calendar_exclusions"."days" IS NULL) OR ("academic"."calendar_exclusions"."date" IS NULL AND "academic"."calendar_exclusions"."period_start" IS NOT NULL AND "academic"."calendar_exclusions"."period_end" IS NOT NULL AND "academic"."calendar_exclusions"."period_start" <= "academic"."calendar_exclusions"."period_end" AND "academic"."calendar_exclusions"."days" >= 0 AND "academic"."calendar_exclusions"."slots_per_day" >= 0)

class_records_correction_reason.name: class_records_correction_reason
class_records_correction_reason.value: "academic"."class_records"."corrects_record_id" IS NULL OR "academic"."class_records"."correction_reason" IS NOT NULL

class_sessions_reason_required.name: class_sessions_reason_required
class_sessions_reason_required.value: "academic"."class_sessions"."status" NOT IN ('cancelled', 'rescheduled') OR "academic"."class_sessions"."status_reason" IS NOT NULL

enrolment_intake_log_outcome_shape.name: enrolment_intake_log_outcome_shape
enrolment_intake_log_outcome_shape.value: ("academic"."enrolment_intake_log"."outcome" = 'confirmed' AND "academic"."enrolment_intake_log"."enrolment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "academic"."enrolment_intake_log"."student_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("academic"."enrolment_intake_log"."outcome" = 'rejected' AND "academic"."enrolment_intake_log"."reason_code" IS NOT NULL)

interventions_outcome_on_resolve.name: interventions_outcome_on_resolve
interventions_outcome_on_resolve.value: "academic"."interventions"."status" NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed') OR "academic"."interventions"."outcome" IS NOT NULL

results_absent_shape.name: results_absent_shape
results_absent_shape.value: ("academic"."results"."absent" AND "academic"."results"."total_score" IS NULL) OR (NOT "academic"."results"."absent" AND "academic"."results"."total_score" IS NOT NULL)

admissions_enrolled_has_ids.name: admissions_enrolled_has_ids
admissions_enrolled_has_ids.value: "ops"."admissions"."status" <> 'enrolled' OR ("ops"."admissions"."enrolment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ops"."admissions"."student_id" IS NOT NULL)

fee_records_direction_check.name: fee_records_direction_check
fee_records_direction_check.value: ("ops"."fee_records"."kind" = 'adjustment') = ("ops"."fee_records"."direction" IS NOT NULL) AND ("ops"."fee_records"."direction" IS NULL OR "ops"."fee_records"."direction" IN ('credit', 'debit'))

fee_records_verified_check.name: fee_records_verified_check
fee_records_verified_check.value: ("ops"."fee_records"."status" <> 'verified' OR ("ops"."fee_records"."verified_by" IS NOT NULL AND "ops"."fee_records"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("ops"."fee_records"."verified_by" IS NULL OR "ops"."fee_records"."verified_by" <> "ops"."fee_records"."recorded_by")

fee_records_voided_check.name: fee_records_voided_check
fee_records_voided_check.value: "ops"."fee_records"."status" <> 'voided' OR ("ops"."fee_records"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "ops"."fee_records"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL)

incidents_resolved_has_resolution.name: incidents_resolved_has_resolution
incidents_resolved_has_resolution.value: "ops"."incidents"."status" NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed') OR "ops"."incidents"."resolution" IS NOT NULL

leads_has_contact.name: leads_has_contact
leads_has_contact.value: "ops"."leads"."student_phone" IS NOT NULL OR "ops"."leads"."student_email" IS NOT NULL OR "ops"."leads"."guardian_phone" IS NOT NULL OR "ops"."leads"."guardian_email" IS NOT NULL

leads_phone_e164.name: leads_phone_e164
leads_phone_e164.value: ("ops"."leads"."student_phone" IS NULL OR "ops"."leads"."student_phone" ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$') AND ("ops"."leads"."guardian_phone" IS NULL OR "ops"."leads"."guardian_phone" ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$')

leads_email_lowercase.name: leads_email_lowercase
leads_email_lowercase.value: ("ops"."leads"."student_email" IS NULL OR "ops"."leads"."student_email" = lower("ops"."leads"."student_email")) AND ("ops"."leads"."guardian_email" IS NULL OR "ops"."leads"."guardian_email" = lower("ops"."leads"."guardian_email"))

projects_dates_order.name: projects_dates_order
projects_dates_order.value: "ops"."projects"."start_date" IS NULL OR "ops"."projects"."end_date" IS NULL OR "ops"."projects"."end_date" >= "ops"."projects"."start_date"

sop_versions_approved_consistency.name: sop_versions_approved_consistency
sop_versions_approved_consistency.value: "ops"."sop_versions"."status" <> 'approved' OR ("ops"."sop_versions"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "ops"."sop_versions"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

sops_legacy_code_has_source.name: sops_legacy_code_has_source
sops_legacy_code_has_source.value: "ops"."sops"."code" NOT LIKE 'LEGACY-%' OR "ops"."sops"."legacy_source" IS NOT NULL

tasks_completed_needs_evidence.name: tasks_completed_needs_evidence
tasks_completed_needs_evidence.value: "ops"."tasks"."status" <> 'completed' OR ("ops"."tasks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND ("ops"."tasks"."completion_note" IS NOT NULL OR "ops"."tasks"."evidence_link" IS NOT NULL))

employee_documents_storage_check.name: employee_documents_storage_check
employee_documents_storage_check.value: ("ops"."employee_documents"."storage_kind" = 'reference' AND "ops"."employee_documents"."external_reference" IS NOT NULL AND "ops"."employee_documents"."storage_key" IS NULL) OR ("ops"."employee_documents"."storage_kind" = 'stored' AND "ops"."employee_documents"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL AND "ops"."employee_documents"."sha256" IS NOT NULL)

employee_records_dates_order.name: employee_records_dates_order
employee_records_dates_order.value: "ops"."employee_records"."employment_end_date" IS NULL OR "ops"."employee_records"."employment_start_date" IS NULL OR "ops"."employee_records"."employment_end_date" >= "ops"."employee_records"."employment_start_date"

candidates_anonymised_no_contacts.name: candidates_anonymised_no_contacts
candidates_anonymised_no_contacts.value: "ops"."candidates"."status" <> 'anonymised' OR ("ops"."candidates"."email" IS NULL AND "ops"."candidates"."phone" IS NULL)

interview_panelists_feedback_consistent.name: interview_panelists_feedback_consistent
interview_panelists_feedback_consistent.value: ("ops"."interview_panelists"."submitted_at" IS NULL) = ("ops"."interview_panelists"."recommendation" IS NULL) AND ("ops"."interview_panelists"."submitted_at" IS NULL) = ("ops"."interview_panelists"."submitted_by" IS NULL)

job_offers_approved_before_extended.name: job_offers_approved_before_extended
job_offers_approved_before_extended.value: "ops"."job_offers"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'extended', 'accepted', 'declined') OR "ops"."job_offers"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL

lifecycle_cases_offboarding_fields.name: lifecycle_cases_offboarding_fields
lifecycle_cases_offboarding_fields.value: "ops"."lifecycle_cases"."kind" <> 'offboarding' OR ("ops"."lifecycle_cases"."separation_type" IS NOT NULL AND "ops"."lifecycle_cases"."last_working_day" IS NOT NULL)

lifecycle_cases_onboarding_fields.name: lifecycle_cases_onboarding_fields
lifecycle_cases_onboarding_fields.value: "ops"."lifecycle_cases"."kind" <> 'onboarding' OR ("ops"."lifecycle_cases"."separation_type" IS NULL AND "ops"."lifecycle_cases"."last_working_day" IS NULL AND "ops"."lifecycle_cases"."separation_reason" IS NULL)

lifecycle_cases_notice_before_lwd.name: lifecycle_cases_notice_before_lwd
lifecycle_cases_notice_before_lwd.value: "ops"."lifecycle_cases"."notice_date" IS NULL OR "ops"."lifecycle_cases"."last_working_day" IS NULL OR "ops"."lifecycle_cases"."notice_date" <= "ops"."lifecycle_cases"."last_working_day"

leave_ledger_request_link.name: leave_ledger_request_link
leave_ledger_request_link.value: "ops"."leave_ledger_entries"."entry_type" NOT IN ('usage', 'reversal') OR "ops"."leave_ledger_entries"."leave_request_id" IS NOT NULL

leave_requests_parts_consistent.name: leave_requests_parts_consistent
leave_requests_parts_consistent.value: ("ops"."leave_requests"."start_date" = "ops"."leave_requests"."end_date" AND "ops"."leave_requests"."start_part" = "ops"."leave_requests"."end_part") OR ("ops"."leave_requests"."start_date" < "ops"."leave_requests"."end_date" AND "ops"."leave_requests"."start_part" IN ('full', 'second_half') AND "ops"."leave_requests"."end_part" IN ('full', 'first_half'))

policies_retired_consistency.name: policies_retired_consistency
policies_retired_consistency.value: ("ops"."policies"."status" = 'retired') = ("ops"."policies"."retired_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ops"."policies"."retired_by" IS NOT NULL AND "ops"."policies"."retired_reason" IS NOT NULL)

policy_versions_review_after_effective.name: policy_versions_review_after_effective
policy_versions_review_after_effective.value: "ops"."policy_versions"."next_review_date" IS NULL OR "ops"."policy_versions"."effective_date" IS NULL OR "ops"."policy_versions"."next_review_date" >= "ops"."policy_versions"."effective_date"

policy_versions_proposed_consistency.name: policy_versions_proposed_consistency
policy_versions_proposed_consistency.value: "ops"."policy_versions"."status" = 'draft' OR ("ops"."policy_versions"."proposed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "ops"."policy_versions"."proposed_at" IS NOT NULL)

policy_versions_decided_consistency.name: policy_versions_decided_consistency
policy_versions_decided_consistency.value: "ops"."policy_versions"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'rejected') OR ("ops"."policy_versions"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "ops"."policy_versions"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

policy_versions_no_self_approval.name: policy_versions_no_self_approval
policy_versions_no_self_approval.value: "ops"."policy_versions"."decided_by" IS NULL OR "ops"."policy_versions"."proposed_by" IS NULL OR "ops"."policy_versions"."decided_by" <> "ops"."policy_versions"."proposed_by"

sop_ack_requirements_audience_target.name: sop_ack_requirements_audience_target
sop_ack_requirements_audience_target.value: ("ops"."sop_ack_requirements"."audience_type" = 'department' AND "ops"."sop_ack_requirements"."department_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ops"."sop_ack_requirements"."role" IS NULL) OR ("ops"."sop_ack_requirements"."audience_type" = 'role' AND "ops"."sop_ack_requirements"."role" IS NOT NULL AND "ops"."sop_ack_requirements"."department_id" IS NULL)

sop_ack_requirements_withdrawn_consisten.name: sop_ack_requirements_withdrawn_consistency
sop_ack_requirements_withdrawn_consisten.value: ("ops"."sop_ack_requirements"."withdrawn_at" IS NULL AND "ops"."sop_ack_requirements"."withdrawn_by" IS NULL AND "ops"."sop_ack_requirements"."withdrawn_reason" IS NULL) OR ("ops"."sop_ack_requirements"."withdrawn_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ops"."sop_ack_requirements"."withdrawn_by" IS NOT NULL AND "ops"."sop_ack_requirements"."withdrawn_reason" IS NOT NULL)

task_comments_hidden_consistency.name: task_comments_hidden_consistency
task_comments_hidden_consistency.value: ("ops"."task_comments"."hidden_at" IS NULL AND "ops"."task_comments"."hidden_by" IS NULL AND "ops"."task_comments"."hidden_reason" IS NULL) OR ("ops"."task_comments"."hidden_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ops"."task_comments"."hidden_by" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("ops"."task_comments"."hidden_reason")) > 0)

task_references_removed_consistency.name: task_references_removed_consistency
task_references_removed_consistency.value: ("ops"."task_references"."removed_at" IS NULL AND "ops"."task_references"."removed_by" IS NULL AND "ops"."task_references"."removed_reason" IS NULL) OR ("ops"."task_references"."removed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ops"."task_references"."removed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "ops"."task_references"."removed_reason" IS NOT NULL)

task_reviews_decision_consistency.name: task_reviews_decision_consistency
task_reviews_decision_consistency.value: ("ops"."task_reviews"."status" = 'pending' AND "ops"."task_reviews"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "ops"."task_reviews"."decided_at" IS NULL) OR ("ops"."task_reviews"."status" <> 'pending' AND "ops"."task_reviews"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "ops"."task_reviews"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)
